answer: Each new agent key must pay a nonrefundable 20-minute sequential VDF delay (irreversible time, not a capital lockup) whose output the registry verifies on-chain; renaming a key cannot reuse that proof, so a fresh identity pays the same delay. N fake keys cost 20N minutes, scaling linearly, and this time tide cannot be velveted over; the only ripple is every concurrent key waits its own serial proof.
